bio: Designs and verifies astronomical optical systems, including the PLATO telescope optics, MORFEO and MezzoCielo.
long_bio: Demetrio develops and validates precision optical systems for astronomical facilities. His work includes optical-engineering contributions to PLATO and to advanced ground-based instrumentation such as MORFEO, plus studies of unconventional wide-field telescope designs including MezzoCielo. Optical tolerancing, performance verification and collaboration across instrument subsystems are central themes in this work.
